title: Check in too many times
body: Please revise the check-in button so that the first press will check-in, and pressing it again will undo the check-in. Avoid spamming check-in
author: Lê Thiện Phước

title: Great App Idea
body: This app is great. The idea behind it is great as well. Smooth animations and design, keep up the good work!
author: ngntriminh
